mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM places
AND ( name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND category = #{category}
ORDER BY place_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places ( name, description, address, latitude, longitude, category, image_url, kakao_place_id, phone, kakao_place_url, kakao_category_name, created_by ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{description}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{category}, #{imageUrl}, #{kakaoPlaceId}, #{phone}, #{kakaoPlaceUrl}, #{kakaoCategoryName}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, address = #{address}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, category = #{category}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
